svg.title: Numerical logistic-map bifurcation diagram
svg.desc: Fixed settings: x0=0.2, 500 transient iterations, 80 tail points at 801 parameter values from 0 to 4. For this initial value a single branch splits into two and four, with irregular bands and periodic windows later. Floating-point illustration, not a proof of stability or chaos.

g.text: One rule. A world of behaviour.
xₙ₊₁ = r xₙ (1 − xₙ) · static numerical fallback
x₀ = 0.2 · skip 500 · plot 80 · floating-point observations, not proof
